purpose: Updated separate animated preview, matched to the existing matte 3D app illustration family.

Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the mosque arcade composition already liked by the user. Image 2 is the PRIMARY STYLE REFERENCE, an existing approved Nur Islam app illustration. Match Image 2's smooth clean matte 3D material and simplified shape language much more faithfully.
Keep Image 1's portrait framing, large quiet deep emerald wall in the middle, close ivory column on the extreme left, arch on the right, small glimpse of a teal dome outside at lower right, warm afternoon light and uncluttered floor. Preserve the central dark-green text-safe area x20%-80%, y12%-76%.
